title: Over 500 again – Cumbria threaten 23 libraries, Bucks 18, Hull 3
author: Ian Anstice / The Library Campaign

editorial.text: 507 libraries (436 buildings and 71 mobiles) currently under threat or closed/left council control since 1/4/11 out of c.4517 in the UK (see the complete tally on the link on the right)
